Subject: Joint adoption kit: MAP + 30-day acceptance slides

Hi Amy / Carlos,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for sharing the high-level goals for your product team. As promised, I put together a concise joint-adoption kit to help structure the evaluation and a suggested 30-day acceptance path. The package is intentionally light so your engineering and product stakeholders can review quickly.

What's attached / linked:
- Redwood_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (starter MAP: roles, milestones, risks, acceptance criteria)
- 30d-Acceptance-Slate.pptx (two-slide summary to share with execs)
- Quick notes in the doc on canary scope + minimal infra reqs

Ask: could you confirm which stakeholders should be on the MAP (tech lead, security reviewer, procurement contact)? If you can share names/emails I’ll add them to the doc and propose a kickoff date.

Suggested next step: 30–45 minute kickoff next week to align goals and pick a 14-day pilot slice (we usually recommend a narrow data slice to validate latency and integration). I’ll tentatively propose Wed/Thu and we can adjust.

Link to live MAP (edit access granted to your domain): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP_TEMPLATE

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

- Security: our InfoSec team requires a brief on data residency and auditability. Do you have a short bullet list we can include in the MAP?
- Timeline: you suggested a 14-day pilot slice — can you outline the milestones you expect during those two weeks (dev work vs validation vs KPI review)?
- Procurement: I’ll loop in our procurement lead (Carlos) — he’s cc'd — for contract/PO timelines. We may need a month lead time on purchase orders.

Prefer kickoff Thu 8th AM PT. Is that ok?

Best,
Amy Wallace

Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint adoption kit: MAP + 30-day acceptance slides

Looping in suggested answers — feel free to forward to Avery as-is.

Amy — quick responses to your bullets: 

- Security bullets to add to MAP (short version for procurement/InfoSec):
  • Data handling: no customer data is persisted by default on Redwood managed hosted inference; KV cache is isolated per tenant and can be disabled.
  • Auditability: request logs and inference traces retained per your retention policy; we can provide export of request IDs and token-level timing for SRE review.
  • Residency & encryption: hosted inference available in us-west & eu-west regions; TLS in transit + KMS-managed keys for at-rest encryption; private deployments support HSM/KMS integration.
  • Compliance artifacts: we can share our SOC 2 Type II summary and recent pen-test report under NDA.

- 14-day pilot milestones (recommended split):
  Day 0–3: integration & smoke tests (API keys, network allowlist, sample prompts)
  Day 4–8: run representative workload; collect latency/cost baselines and early prompts for quality review
  Day 9–11: iterate prompt set and routing; enable prefix/KV caching for test cases
  Day 12–14: acceptance review (SLA metrics, quality gate), stakeholder demo, and sign-off checklist

I attached a very short two-slide update (30d-Acceptance-Slate.pptx) you can share with execs. Also added a small security appendix to the MAP doc (comments).

HubSpot deal for internal tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (DEAL-AVY-0042)

Grace — if you can confirm kickoff Thu 8th 9:00–9:45 AM PT (I can take notes and own the acceptance checklist) I’ll create the MAP milestones in the doc and tag owners.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: 30d-Acceptance-Slate.pptx (slide deck stub)

Thanks — Thu 8th 9:00 AM PT works for us. I’ve added the tentative kickoff to the MAP (see comments) and assigned action owners for the week-0 smoke tests. Carlos — appreciate if you can confirm procurement lead / PO timing during the call; we’ll note any constraint in the MAP timeline.

Quick note on cutover options: we can run the pilot on Redwood Hosted with an option to move to Dedicated capacity before pilot close if you prefer isolation. I’ll bring Ben (solutions for quant/perf tuning) to the kickoff to run through quick latency knobs.

See you Thu — calendar invite to follow.

Grace
